result.title: Coinbase on OpenAI Private Intelligence
result.description:
For Coinbase, putting frontier AI to work starts with control over its data.

Every employee has access to the latest OpenAI models. In this video, Rob Witoff explains why security, guardrails, and zero data retention are central to that trust. As he puts it: “It’s still our data.”

OpenAI Private Intelligence gives businesses stronger controls over their data while using our most capable models. We’re building these protections with some of our largest customers to help businesses apply frontier AI to their most sensitive work.

Learn more about OpenAI Private Intelligence: https://openai.com/business/private-intelligence/

result.title: There are many futures. Which do you want to build?
How Gen uses ChatGPT Work to turn data Into decisions | OpenAI
result.description:
“Before ChatGPT Work, we were walking. Now with ChatGPT Work, we are running.”

For Gen's Howie Xu, that means understanding how a new product’s onboarding experience is working within two or three hours of release.

Finding answers used to mean repeated handoffs across teams, functions, and time zones. ChatGPT Work is shortening that feedback loop.

Watch how Howie turns business data into decisions while the work is still happening.
